title: The Enchanted Market at The Briars
summary: Family-friendly market inside The Briars wildlife reserve: homemade and homegrown stalls, regional produce, craft, walking trails and native wildlife on the doorstep.
recurrenceNote: Every 2–3 months (irregular; check website for dates)
accessibilityNotes: Walking trails; wildlife reserve; some uneven terrain
weatherDependency: Outdoor – weather dependent; shade available under trees
nearbyAttractions: The Briars homestead and sanctuary; Mount Martha beach; Mount Martha House
suggestedItineraryPairing: Market + Briars wildlife walk + beach picnic
editorVerdict: A market that doubles as a bushwalk. The setting inside The Briars is the reason to make the trip.
editorNote:
The Enchanted Market is the every-couple-of-months market inside The Briars wildlife reserve at Mount Martha. Stallholders bring homemade, homegrown and craft, but the venue is the headline: boardwalks, native bush, kangaroos and emus a short walk from the stalls.

Do the market in an hour, then walk the sanctuary loop. Pack a picnic for the lawn, then drive down to Mount Martha South Beach for the afternoon.

Dates are irregular and not all listed in advance, so check the Shire markets page before assuming it's on.
